title: "Linear Depletion" implemented as exponential decay: rewardPerSecond re-anchored on every interaction (~63% delivered in-window, stranded tail)
description: The protocol's headline advertised mechanism is "Linear Depletion": a reward tranche should pay out linearly over depletionDuration. collectReward sets rewardPerSecond = rewardBalance*PRECISION/depletionDuration (L283). However on every stake/withdraw/claim/collectReward, _updatePool distributes accrued reward, debits rewardBalance (L413), then RE-ANCHORS rewardPerSecond = (reduced rewardBalance)*PRECISION/depletionDuration (L416). Re-anchoring restarts the full depletion window against an ever-shrinking balance on each interaction, converting the intended linear depletion into exponential decay. Over one nominal window only ~1-(1-1/e) ~ 63% is delivered; the remaining ~37% is pushed into an ever-receding tail, and once the per-update reward falls below 1 wei/share the tail permanently stalls with a residual stranded in rewardBalance.
impact: Reward stream under-delivered to every staker passively: each tranche pays only ~63% within its intended depletion window; ~37% is delayed into a receding tail and a residual is stranded. No principal at risk, no theft, and the stranded remainder is recoverable only by owner emergencyTransfer. This materially degrades the protocol's headline advertised feature and leaks/strands value (in-motion reward yield) under normal usage.
attackPath: 1. No attacker required - emergent from normal usage.

recommendation: Do not re-anchor rewardPerSecond on routine pool updates. Anchor the rate and an end-of-window timestamp once at funding (collectReward / setDepletionDuration) and let _updatePool distribute against that fixed schedule (rate * elapsed) until the window closes, rather than recomputing rewardPerSecond from the residual balance on every interaction. (This is exactly what upstream PhlimboV2/story-020 does by removing the recompute.) V1 is frozen/deployed, so the actionable output is operational awareness of the under-delivery plus owner sweep of the stranded tail.
